extracted.name: Hummus rainbow wraps
extracted.description: Make these colourful rainbow wraps, with hummus, beetroot, carrot, feta and baby spinach for a quick and easy veggie lunch for the whole family
ingredient_lines: 3-4 wraps (1/2 a wrap will be enough for a smaller child)
instruction_lines: Spread the wraps with the hummus, then fill with the carrot, beetroot, spinach and feta, for those who want it. Wrap and save for lunchtime or eat straightaway.
